period.note: Source wording: "18%/năm đến tối đa 49%/năm"; interest = sum(daily balance x days x rate) / 365 (tariff V18 and contract terms).

amortization.note: No document names the repayment method. Inferred from: (1) the page example 300M / 48 months / 18% = 8,812,500 per month (annuity formula 8,812,500); (2) the page's public calculator returns an equal instalment in every period, equal to the annuity at 18%/year (10M/12m = 916,800; 100M/48m = 2,937,500; 500M/60m = 12,696,714; read 2026-11-03); (3) the 'landing' page example 60M / 12 months = 5,500,800 (annuity 5,500,800); (4) the contract template (item 2) says a fixed monthly principal-and-interest amount, except the first and last instalments. A Shinhan blog post of 2026-10-16 illustrates 'reducing balance' with equal-principal arithmetic instead; see conflicts.

The application form (V04-08/2026) also has a line "Mua bảo hiểm - Tôi xác nhận việc mua bảo hiểm là hoàn toàn tự nguyện", and Shinhan's blog of 2026-10-16 says "Loan insurance is not a mandatory fee for all loans" and lists "Optional insurance". Not seen: whether the insurance option is pre-selected in the app.

collection.note: The loan contract template lists two purposes for the loan amount: the consumer/living purpose and "Phí bảo hiểm Shinhan - Vững Tin". The disbursement form pays the loan by transfer "ngoại trừ (các) Phí bảo hiểm", and contract terms 3.1(c) allow paying the premium straight to the insurer. So the premium is financed inside the loan and not paid out to the borrower.

representativeExamples.note: Page example (re-read 2026-11-03): "khoản vay tín chấp 300 triệu đồng, kỳ hạn vay 48 tháng, lãi suất 18%/năm trên dư nợ giảm dần", monthly principal+interest 8,812,500 VND. Checked: annuity formula gives about 8,812,480, so the page figure is consistent. Instalment type is our inference (not named on page). Page says figures are reference only. Fees/insurance not included.

Output of the product page's public calculator (input: 100,000,000 VND, 48 months, income left at 0), read 2026-11-03: 48 equal instalments of 2,937,500 VND. The calculator uses the minimum rate (its configuration says INTEREST_RATE 18%) and ignores income, fees and insurance. Annuity formula at 18%/year gives 2,937,500. This is the best case, not a typical borrower's offer.

Google Play listing of the iShinhan app (the App Store listing has the same text): 100 million for 12 months at 18%/year, monthly 9,167,999, total 109,998,800 VND, "Miễn phí xử lý hồ sơ". The listing does not name the interest basis; the monthly figure equals the reducing-balance annuity at 18%/year. But 12 x 9,167,999 = 110,015,988, which is 17,188 VND more than the stated total (perhaps daily-interest rounding), so the example does not add up exactly; do not use as a test fixture. The same listing says up to 300 million and 18-35%/year, older than the product page.

products.notes: Re-researched 2026-11-03. Rate 18-49%/year on declining balance is on the product page and in the interest-rate and fee policy V18 effective 29/05/2026 (scanned PDF, read visually), so it is current and not contradicted by a newer source. The V18 tariff lists only one cost beyond interest: an early-repayment fee of 6% of the prepaid amount, minimum 1,500,000 VND, plus on-request document fees; it says no other fee is charged during appraisal and approval, and the contract template adds only third-party collection charges. Insurance ("Phí bảo hiểm Shinhan - Vững Tin") is optional per the contract terms, and its premium is financed inside the loan; the premium rate is not published anywhere we found. A late-payment penalty has no fixed fee; overdue principal is charged 150% of the in-term rate. The product page's public calculator uses the 18% minimum rate only, so it understates what most borrowers will pay.

researchNotes: LICENSING: matched in data/licensed-institutions.json (id shinhan-finance, finance_company, licence 16/GP-NHNN dated 12/8/2022). One Shinhan blog post of 2026-10-15 prints licence '51/GP-NHNN' while others print 16/GP-NHNN; the licensed list says 16/GP-NHNN. RE-RESEARCH 2026-11-03. KEY FINDINGS: (1) The public FAQ block on the unsecured-loan page was hidden in the page's data and links the current documents: tariff 'Chính sách lãi suất, phí và công thức tính lãi' V18 effective 29/05/2026 (scanned), loan contract, basic terms, repayment schedule, disbursement form, application form and use-of-funds form, all V03-08/2026 or similar. (2) Cash loan costs: 18-49%/year on declining balance; early-repayment fee 6% of the prepaid amount with a 1,500,000 VND minimum; document fees (110,000 / 55,000 / 165,000 / 220,000 / 550,000 VND); overdue principal at 150% of the in-term rate; late interest 10%/year; no other fee in appraisal and approval. (3) Optional insurance 'Phí bảo hiểm Shinhan - Vững Tin' is financed inside the loan; its premium rate is not published in any source found. (4) The cash-loan limit was raised to 500 million and the term to 60 months (announcement 2026-08-06); the calculator now agrees (10M-500M, 12-60 months). The calculator and the page's examples are annuities at the 18% minimum. (5) Installment: still tariff V4.3 (03/03/2025); the 0-59% figure is a framework, so it is now regulatory_ceiling. A newer contract template (11/2025) shows different early-repayment bands and a 45%/year 'normal' rate. Motorbike: no rate or term published anywhere official. (6) New product: Tài Tốc (Express Loan), 10-100M, 12-48 months, 'từ 30%', reducing balance, no product page. GAPS (searched, not published): insurance premium and insurer for Vững Tin and installment insurance; single maximum age; motorbike rate and term; Tài Tốc rate unit and fees; credit card fee schedule (Credit-Card-Tariff_VN.pdf not read this pass). CONTRADICTIONS (also in conflicts[]): max 500M (page, calculator, announcement) vs 300M (Play/App Store listing text) and both above the 100M finance-company cap in Circular 43/2016 art. 3(1) (lawyer to confirm); term 12-60 vs 12-48 (landing page, listings); max rate 49% vs 35% (landing page, listings); age to retirement vs 21-55 f/58 m (landing page, 2025 blog) vs 21-65 (2026 blog); equal-instalment (calculator) vs equal-principal (blog illustrations); early-repayment bands in tariff V4.3 vs contract template 11/2025. SURPRISING: early repayment on the cash loan costs 6% of the prepaid amount with a 1,500,000 VND minimum whatever the time left; the Play and App Store listings still advertise 300M / 35% / 48 months; the example total in the listing is 17,188 VND below 12 x its monthly instalment.
